native: release, mimalloc, no default RocksDB feature
scope: Whole job, including planning/startup, both row/Arrow conversions and production JNI. Cohorts use fresh JVMs; stock and StreamFusion trials alternate. No other task build or test overlaps timing. Background desktop activity is uncontrolled.

stages.baseline: Original planner encoder, DECIMAL setter and native DSO, with identical benchmark fixture. Initial cases ran before implementation; remaining controls use the frozen original classes and DSO.
stages.candidate: Rust search kernels; original DECIMAL setter. Final non-DECIMAL code is unchanged by the later DECIMAL setter optimization.
stages.optimized: Rust search kernels plus signed-long write for wide-precision decimals whose actual unscaled value fits.
stages.kernel: Rust kernels with the frozen original DECIMAL setter; wide-value control.
stages.optimized-repeat: Repeat of the final wide-value control in another fresh JVM.

unmatched_reason: Constant CONTAINS probes preceded discovery of needle-nullability restrictions. They do not represent an admitted Rust path and are excluded from primary comparisons.

fixture.array_values: (31 * elementIndex + row) % domain - domain / 2; BOOLEAN uses parity; DECIMAL optionally adds decimalOffset before conversion to DECIMAL(38,18)
